More predictable performance, lower interface overhead, and complete multilingual language selection.

## Highlights

- Replaces continuously rendered Whisper output with a lightweight activity summary while preserving complete logs in every result folder.
- Adds model-aware Metal scheduling based on live GPU, memory, CPU, power, and thermal conditions.
- Uses Apple performance-core topology when assigning CPU helper threads.
- Adds all 100 languages supported by the bundled multilingual Whisper runtime, including Cantonese.
- Clarifies that Auto selects one dominant language for the whole file.
- Keeps transcription quality settings fixed while scheduling changes worker count and throughput.

## Install

Download **Transcriber-1.2.0-macOS-arm64.zip**, unzip it, and move `Transcriber.app` to Applications.

**Requirements:** Apple Silicon and macOS 13.3 or newer.

If macOS blocks the first launch, Control-click `Transcriber.app`, choose **Open**, then confirm **Open**.

[Compare changes from v1.1.0](https://github.com/Pluze/transcriber/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0)
